sources.title: Toy Robot: Toy Classification Using CNN - sammyshaw.github.io
sources.snippet: For this project I trained a Convolutional Neural Network to recognize distinct classes of toys from a bespoke, self-collected data set. After experimenting with various training parameters and model architectures, however, I used transfer learning - and the power of MobilenetV2 - to achieve a 100 percent test set accuracy.
